# Anti-Slop: Frontend DON'Ts

What NOT to do when designing a UI or page. This is a filter, not a style; it never prescribes a look. Stacking several of the below is what reads as AI-made on sight. Adaptive, so if the user or another skill asks for something specific, do that instead; these are defaults, not overrides.

- purple / indigo / violet accent, or a purple-to-blue hero gradient (the top AI tell)
- `bg-clip-text` gradient headline text
- cream (`#faf8f4`) as the whole-page background
- aurora blobs / glowing colored shadows, or an identical glow on every card
- Inter everywhere, or Geist / Space Grotesk / Instrument Serif / Roboto / Arial as your only identity
- gray-400 / gray-500 body text
- one font weight and size throughout (no hierarchy)
- tracked all-caps micro-kickers above every section
- centered hero of eyebrow pill + headline + two CTAs
- the identical 3-card feature grid with a lucide icon in a rounded square
- an 8+ word, 48px+ headline that says nothing

- `rounded-2xl`, or any single radius, on every element
- glassmorphism blur + border + shadow on every surface
- `hover:scale-105` lift on cards
- emoji as feature icons (🚀 ⚡ ✨ 🎯 💡)
- left-border accent cards, a colored border on a rounded element, or cards nested inside cards
- fade-up / slide-up on everything as it scrolls in

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title></title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #090605; }
  body { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; width: 100dvw; height: 100dvh; touch-action: none; cursor: crosshair; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { canvas { cursor: default; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, CX = 0, CY = 0, R = 0;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var mouse = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5, inside: false, heat: 0, thet: 0 };
  var steam = [], dust = [], ripples = [];
  var lastRipple = 0, start = performance.now();

  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR); canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    CX = W / 2; CY = H * 0.54; R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.335;
    if (R < 120) R = Math.max(90, Math.min(W, H) * 0.42);
    if (reduced) draw(0);
  }

  function initParticles() {
    steam = []; dust = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 42; i++) steam.push(newSteam(true));
    for (var j = 0; j < 46; j++) dust.push({ x: Math.random(), y: Math.random(), r: rand(0.6, 2.2), s: rand(0.2, 1), p: rand(0, 6.28), v: rand(0.006, 0.02) });
  }
  function newSteam(anywhere) {
    return { x: rand(-0.62, 0.62), y: anywhere ? rand(0, 1) : 0, life: anywhere ? Math.random() : 0,
      max: rand(2.8, 5.2), wob: rand(0.6, 1.6), phase: rand(0, 6.28), size: rand(0.10, 0.24) };
  }

  function onMove(x, y) {
    mouse.tx = x / Math.max(1, W); mouse.ty = y / Math.max(1, H); mouse.inside = true;
    if (!reduced && performance.now() - lastRipple > 260) {
      var dx = (x - CX) / R, dy = (y - (CY - R * 0.34)) / (R * 0.30);
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 1.1) { ripples.push({ r: 0.08, a: 0.35 }); lastRipple = performance.now(); }
      if (ripples.length > 5) ripples.shift();
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { onMove(e.clientX, e.clientY); }, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    onMove(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (!reduced) ripples.push({ r: 0.05, a: 0.55 });
  }, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { mouse.inside = false; });
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { mouse.inside = false; });
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  // ---------- drawing helpers ----------
  function ellipse(x, y, rx, ry) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, 6.2832); }
  function brothY() { return CY - R * 0.36; }

  function drawBackground(t, px, py) {
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX + px * 18, CY - R * 0.2 + py * 12, R * 0.1, CX, CY, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#241207'); g.addColorStop(0.38, '#150b06'); g.addColorStop(0.72, '#0a0605'); g.addColorStop(1, '#050303');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // ambient warmth behind bowl (follows pointer gently)
    var gx = CX + px * R * 0.55, gy = CY - R * 0.28 + py * R * 0.22;
    var warm = 0.55 + mouse.heat * 0.45;
    var wg = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, R * (1.55 + mouse.heat * 0.25));
    wg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,138,42,' + (0.20 * warm) + ')');
    wg.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(214,84,22,' + (0.11 * warm) + ')');
    wg.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(120,40,10,0.04)'); wg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = wg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // table
    var tableY = CY + R * 0.62;
    var tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tableY - R * 0.1, 0, H);
    tg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(58,30,16,0.55)'); tg.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(28,16,10,0.35)'); tg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = tg; ctx.fillRect(0, tableY - R * 0.1, W, H - tableY + R * 0.1);
    // dust motes in warm light
    if (!reduced) {
      for (var i = 0; i < dust.length; i++) {
        var d = dust[i];
        d.y -= d.v * 0.0035; d.x += Math.sin(t * 0.0004 + d.p) * 0.00012;
        if (d.y < -0.02) { d.y = 1.02; d.x = Math.random(); }
        var tw = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 0.001 * d.s + d.p));
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x * W, d.y * H, d.r, 0, 6.2832);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,176,102,' + (0.13 * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawShadow(px) {
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(px * 10, 0);
    ellipse(CX, CY + R * 0.66, R * 1.02, R * 0.16);
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY + R * 0.66, 0, CX, CY + R * 0.66, R * 1.02);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)'); g.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    // warm reflection on table
    ellipse(CX, CY + R * 0.70, R * 0.72, R * 0.09);
    var rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY + R * 0.70, 0, CX, CY + R * 0.70, R * 0.72);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,110,30,' + (0.10 + mouse.heat * 0.08) + ')'); rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,110,30,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg; ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBowlBack(px, py) {
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(px * 8, py * 5);
    // foot
    ctx.fillStyle = '#17100d';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(CX - R * 0.34, CY + R * 0.52); ctx.lineTo(CX + R * 0.34, CY + R * 0.52);
    ctx.lineTo(CX + R * 0.27, CY + R * 0.66); ctx.lineTo(CX - R * 0.27, CY + R * 0.66); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(CX - R * 1.02, brothY());
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(CX - R * 1.0, CY + R * 0.28, CX - R * 0.62, CY + R * 0.56, CX - R * 0.30, CY + R * 0.60);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(CX - R * 0.10, CY + R * 0.635, CX + R * 0.10, CY + R * 0.635, CX + R * 0.30, CY + R * 0.60);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(CX + R * 0.62, CY + R * 0.56, CX + R * 1.0, CY + R * 0.28, CX + R * 1.02, brothY());
    ctx.closePath();
    var bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(CX - R, CY, CX + R, CY + R * 0.6);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#2b1a13'); bg.addColorStop(0.28, '#3d2318'); bg.addColorStop(0.52, '#1c110c');
    bg.addColorStop(0.78, '#140c09'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#24130d');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fill();
    // glaze sheen, shifts with pointer
    ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
    var sx = CX - R * 0.45 + px * R * 0.35;
    var sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, CY + R * 0.05, 0, sx, CY + R * 0.05, R * 0.75);
    sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,176,110,0.16)'); sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,176,110,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.fillRect(CX - R * 1.1, CY - R * 0.5, R * 2.2, R * 1.3);
    // thin decorative ring on bowl
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(217,122,52,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.012);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(CX, CY + R * 0.30, R * 0.84, R * 0.20, 0, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBroth(t, px, py) {
    var by = brothY();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(px * 8, py * 5);
    // rim
    ellipse(CX, by, R * 1.02, R * 0.315); ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0906'; ctx.fill();
    ellipse(CX, by, R * 0.97, R * 0.29);
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX - R * 0.25, by - R * 0.06, R * 0.05, CX, by, R * 0.98);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#e08a35'); g.addColorStop(0.32, '#b45f22'); g.addColorStop(0.62, '#7e3a15'); g.addColorStop(1, '#4a2110');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
    ctx.save(); ellipse(CX, by, R * 0.97, R * 0.29); ctx.clip();
    // shimmering oil sheen following pointer
    var hx = CX + px * R * 0.5, hy = by + py * R * 0.12;
    var og = ctx.createRadialGradient(hx, hy, 0, hx, hy, R * 0.62);
    og.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,196,96,' + (0.22 + mouse.heat * 0.12) + ')'); og.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,196,96,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = og; ctx.fillRect(CX - R, by - R * 0.35, R * 2, R * 0.7);
    // ripples
    for (var ri = ripples.length - 1; ri >= 0; ri--) {
      var rp = ripples[ri]; rp.r += 0.012; rp.a -= 0.006;
      if (rp.a <= 0) { ripples.splice(ri, 1); continue; }
      ellipse(CX + px * R * 0.3, by + py * R * 0.08, R * rp.r, R * rp.r * 0.30);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,205,130,' + rp.a.toFixed(3) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.stroke();
    }
    // noodles: layered wavy strokes
    var sway = reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.0011) * R * 0.006 + px * R * 0.012;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (var i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      var seed = i * 137.5, nx = CX + Math.sin(seed) * R * 0.72, ny = by + Math.cos(seed * 1.3) * R * 0.16;
      var len = R * (0.22 + ((i * 53) % 40) / 100);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nx - len / 2, ny);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(nx - len * 0.2, ny - R * 0.045 + sway, nx + len * 0.2, ny + R * 0.045 - sway, nx + len / 2, ny - R * 0.01);
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? 'rgba(246,199,118,0.88)' : 'rgba(232,170,84,0.70)';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, R * 0.016); ctx.stroke();
    }
    drawToppings(t, by);
    // chilli oil droplets + scallion sparkle
    for (var k = 0; k < 22; k++) {
      var a = k * 2.399, rr = Math.sqrt(k / 22) * R * 0.82;
      var dx = CX + Math.cos(a) * rr, dy = by + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.27;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, Math.max(0.8, R * 0.011 * (1 + (k % 3) * 0.4)), 0, 6.2832);
      ctx.fillStyle = k % 4 === 0 ? 'rgba(86,164,62,0.9)' : 'rgba(196,52,20,0.55)'; ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // rim highlights
    ellipse(CX, by, R * 1.02, R * 0.315);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,178,110,0.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.014); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,160,' + (0.45 + mouse.heat * 0.3) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, R * 0.02); ctx.stroke();

    place(-0.52, -0.28, function () {

    // mushroom slices
    [[0.34, -0.42], [0.52, -0.08]].forEach(function (p) {
      place(p[0], p[1], function () {

        ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6248'; ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R * 0.058, R * 0.034, p[0], 0, 6.2832);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#d9b98f'; ctx.fill();
      });
    });

      ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c230';
      [[0, 0], [R * 0.05, R * 0.02], [-R * 0.04, R * 0.03], [R * 0.02, -R * 0.04]].forEach(function (c) {

    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY - R * 0.2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.32, CX, CY, Math.max(W, H) * 0.72);

    dt = dt || 0.016;
    mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * 0.055; mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * 0.055;

    drawShadow(px);
    drawBowlBack(px, py);
    drawBroth(t, px, py);
    drawChopsticks(t, px, py);
    drawSteam(t, dt, px);
    drawVignette();

  var last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
    draw(now - start, dt);
    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  initParticles();
  resize();
  if (reduced) { draw(900); } else { window.requestAnimationFrame(frame); }

import re, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/app/index.html')
s = p.read_text()
assert '<canvas' in s and '<style>' in s and '<script>' in s, "missing inline parts"
# zero external assets: no src/href/link/img/import/url(http)
bad = re.findall(r'(?:src|href)\s*=|@import|<link|<img|url\(\s*["\']?https?:', s, re.I)
assert not bad, f"external refs: {bad}"
assert 'http://' not in s and 'https://' not in s, "external URL found"
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in s, "reduced motion missing"
assert 'pointermove' in s and 'requestAnimationFrame' in s, "interaction/animation missing"
# visible text purity: body outside script/style/canvas should have no text nodes
body = re.search(r'<body>(.*?)</body>', s, re.S).group(1)
body_no_script = re.sub(r'<script>.*?</script>', '', body, flags=re.S)
text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', body_no_script).strip()
assert text == '', f"visible text found: {text!r}"
# crude JS brace/paren balance
js = re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>', s, re.S).group(1)
for a,b in [('{','}'),('(',')'),('[',']')]:
    assert js.count(a)==js.count(b), (a, js.count(a), js.count(b))
print(f"OK bytes={len(s)} js_chars={len(js)} external_refs=0 visible_text=0")
